shared_elements: relief carving covering the whole convex face of a rounded boulder
curvilinear/rounded contour following the block's shape
justification: A depicts a single large zoomorphic body in bold, plastic high relief, coiled in profile with rounded limbs, an eye and massive rounded haunches; B depicts no creature at all but stacked horizontal registers of rectilinear, grid- and panel-like geometric motifs in shallow, low relief. The only correspondence is the generic one that both designs are cut across the whole rounded face of a boulder and follow its curvature, which any tradition working on boulders could produce independently.
